# Mohammed Usamah

> AI/ML engineer building computer vision models, NLP / agent systems, digital twins, and Unreal Engine 5 Python editor tools. Available for freelance and contract work.

Mohammed Usamah (also known as M-Usamah) trains custom models and ships production tooling. He currently builds Unreal Engine 5.6 Python plugins at InfotainmentAcademy, works as an AI/ML engineer at JayzenAI, and takes freelance computer-vision and NLP projects.
